definition: This dimension controls the rate at which skills improve through use, varying from slow, deliberate progression to rapid, accelerated learning. Different games may implement this through mechanics like experience points, usage frequency, or external factors influencing training speed.
exclusion_criteria: Automatic level-ups that do not require skill usage
Uniform training speed across all skills
inclusion_criteria: Character skills improve at varying rates based on usage frequency
Different skills may have distinct training speeds
title: Training Speed Variability
